Stand relaxed with your head facing forward. Wrap the tape around the neck just below the larynx (Adam\'s apple), perpendicular to the long axis of the neck. Keep the tape level — not slanting downward at the front. Read at the end of a normal exhale.

Stand relaxed and breathe out. Wrap the tape around the natural waist — the narrowest point of the torso, typically about 2.5 cm (1 in) above the navel. Keep the tape parallel to the floor and snug, but not compressing the skin.
Stand with feet together. Wrap the tape around the widest part of your buttocks/hips — check sideways in a mirror to find it. Keep the tape level all the way around and snug, not tight.

Stand relaxed with arms at your sides. Wrap the tape around the fullest part of your chest — across the nipple line for men, across the bust for women. Keep it level all the way around and read at the end of a normal exhale.

Let the arm hang relaxed at your side. Find the midpoint between the tip of the shoulder and the elbow. Wrap the tape around the bicep at that midpoint, perpendicular to the long axis of the arm. Keep the tape snug but not compressing.

Stand with weight evenly on both feet. Wrap the tape around the largest part of the upper thigh, just below the gluteal fold. Keep the tape parallel to the floor and snug, but not compressing the muscle.
